description: Costs 2¢ per call. Semantic search across every datasheet already extracted (not every part that exists), for spec-based discovery such as 'low-noise LDO with PSRR above 70dB'. Returns matching chunks with part_number and a 0-100 relevance_score. To find a specific part by number, use search_parts.

section_type.description: Optional: limit search to a specific section type
